text: Marie: Quick a11y pass on the new 'insights' table — noticed a few items: focus outline disappears on dark theme, keyboard nav skips row actions, VoiceOver repeats 'button' twice for the row expand, some toggles report aria-checked wrong. Posting quick repros. a11y-bot: Automated scan results: 12 contrast fails (table row hover bg on dark), 3 aria-warning (toggle missing aria-checked), 2 duplicate-announcement (VO). Report: https://internal/reports/a11y/2003456789 (mock link). Chet: Thanks. Can you paste minimal repro steps? Marie: Steps: 1) Settings > Console > Insights table. 2) Enable dark theme. 3) Tab into table header then use arrow keys to move through rows. Expected: focus ring visible + row actions reachable. Actual: focus outline lost on row cells; tab jumps to end. Repro snippet:```html Model ``` Sam: I can take the keyboard nav fix. Quick question — are we intentionally using role='row' with nested buttons? Sometimes VoiceOver says 'button group' and repeats. Marie: Not intentional. We wrapped buttons in a div role='group' to get layout, but probably should remove role or mark icon-only as aria-hidden/presentation. Also toggles are custom and use aria-pressed instead of aria-checked; that might be why screen readers misreport. Jules: UX note — we don't want a heavy focus ring on low-contrast elements. Can we try a 2px outline with contrast ratio >=3:1 against the background? Also respect prefers-reduced-motion for the focus pulse. Chet: Proposed quick fix: add focus-visible outline and a dark-theme fallback: ```css :root[data-theme='dark'] .cell:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); box-shadow:none; } ``` Also change toggles to use role='switch' + aria-checked=true/false and handle Space key for toggle. Marie: Also seeing double announcement when expanding row — VoiceOver says 'expand button, expanded, row content' then repeats row content. Likely a live region is being updated and the button state change is also announced. Suggest move live updates to an aria-live='polite' container and only write minimal text (e.g., "Row expanded") or remove live update when the screen reader already announces the state. a11y-bot: Additional suggestions: add aria-hidden='true' to decorative SVGs, ensure tabindex order is logical (tabindex='-1' for non-focusable row wrappers), and re-run Axe after fixes. Sam: I'll open a small PR tonight: change role/aria for toggles, remove role='group' on action wrapper, add focus-visible styles, and add a11y tests (voiceover script + axe). Assigning to @Chet for review. :thumbsup: Chet: Great. Please include before/after screenshots and a short VoiceOver recording notes in the PR description so QA can verify.
